AMO Phacoflex SI‐18 NGB and Phaco Flex II SI‐20 NGB silicone IOL material are resistant to UV light degradation after a simulated 5O years of exposure.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the photochemical stability of silicone intraocular lens (SIOL) materials.
the photoaging of IOL materials.
the development of an updated photoaging model for the application of IOL materials.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
these two silicone lens materials have been shown to be stable for a 50 year period of simulated in vivo UV exposure.
these silicone IOL materials have been shown to be resistant to the effects of UV light degradation over a simulated 25 to 50 year in vivo period of exposure.
these materials are photostable for at least 50 years of intraocular exposure to sunlight, which is the expected lifetime of an intraocular implant.
